name: YFlix Local
description: Independent YFlix.in providers for Nuvio. S1 resolves PlayAPI multi-source streams, S2 resolves VidBolt multi-dubbed streams, and S4 resolves verified FilmU multi-audio HLS. S3 remains omitted because its current terminal streams return 403.

scrapers.name: YFlix · Server 1
scrapers.description: YFlix Server 1 (Multi Source): direct PlayAPI stream API using TMDB IDs. DahmerMovies is filtered after device playback failures.
scrapers.author: YFlix Local

scrapers.name: YFlix · Server 2
scrapers.description: YFlix Server 2 (Multi Dubbed): direct VidBolt backend. Callisto provides multi-language HLS/MP4 for movies and TV; Orion adds a direct movie HLS fallback.
scrapers.author: YFlix Local

scrapers.name: YFlix · Server 4
scrapers.description: YFlix Server 4 (Multi Audio): verified FilmU Pulsar multi-audio HLS plus Singularity fallback. Required FilmU Origin/Referer playback headers are preserved.
scrapers.author: YFlix Local
